entries.title: The paperwork began
entries.body: The administrative work for the home began in December 2024. Its individual documents and dates have not yet been added to this public record.

entries.title: Construction began on site
entries.body: The physical build started on 6 March 2026. Dated work notes, attendance and costs will appear as their records are reconciled.

entries.title: Owner's stage report: ground-floor lintel and brickwork
entries.body: In the owner's report dated 28 September 2026, the ground-floor lintel is complete at approximately 8 ft, and red-brick walls continue to approximately 11 ft. The ground-floor RCC roof has not yet been cast. The owner estimates total spending so far at approximately ₹24–26 lakh, including labour, cement, TMT steel, M-sand, P-sand, 20 mm and 40 mm jalli, and associated costs. The precise dates when the lintel and wall heights were reached, and itemised payments, have not been supplied.
